text:
anya: Quick kickoff  we need a small, technical-first beta for Private/Dedicated focusing on onboarding automation + business KPIs. Goal: 6 partners, 8-week engagements.
carl: Keep it narrow. Propose waves of 2 so we can iterate the runbook after each pair.
emma: Signals for invites: infra maturity, compliance, willingness to share anon telemetry, and a clear KPI to tie back to.
lee: Ops asks: expected QPS per partner? token lengths? need those to size pools and pick kernels.
anya: Proposal: steady QPS 5-25, peak 50, 95th token length ~128 tokens typical. We'll confirm per-partner in intake.
devon: I'll build an intake form + scoring rubric. Draft fields: company, preferred deployment (VPC/on-prem), avg/peak QPS, 95th token length estimate, infra maturity (1-5), compliance tags, willing to share anon logs? Y/N, primary infra contact, exec sponsor.
cs-bot: cs-bot: exported shortlist (12). Recommend initial outreach to top 8 after scoring.
carl: Success criteria suggestion: (1) provisioning within SLA for 4/6 partners, (2) preflight automation passes without manual fix for >=3 partners, (3) 95th pctl latency within SLO for 10 business days for at least 3 partners, (4) partner satisfaction >=8/10 for 4 partners. All required for GA signal.
lee: Provisioning SLAs: VPC <=3 biz days; assisted on-prem <=7 biz days. No onsite unless exec-approved. Also require partners to confirm maintenance windows.
anya: Owners: product (anya) handles outreach copy + compensation options; devon builds intake + scoring; lee prototypes preflight + provisioning checklist; cs to vet shortlist. Timeline: intake live in 3 business days, outreach in 5.
devon: Intake snippet I'll wire now:
```
Company name:
Preferred deployment: VPC / on-prem
Avg QPS (per min):
Peak QPS expected:
95th token length (est):
Infra maturity (1-5):
Compliance constraints (HIPAA/GDPR/None):
Willing to share anonymized logs? Y/N
Primary infra contact (name/email):
Exec sponsor (name/email):
Preferred handshake windows
```
I'll attach a scoring weight for infra maturity and log-sharing.
carl: Add KPI field if partner can share a business metric (optional). That lets us test ROI stories.
anya: Legal: include telemetry checkbox + 90-day retention note. Dev and legal to draft short copy.
cs-bot: cs-bot: shortlisted candidates now in Drive; will surface top 8 once intake scoring is done.
lee: I'll add a short preflight that checks network connectivity, DNS, TLS, KMS decrypt, and a smoke inference. Make it runnable by partner or remote-assist.
anya: Final ask: devon publishes intake + rubric by 1807778400, lee to prototype preflight by 1807778600, I'll draft outreach copy by 1807779000. Well review and start wave 1 invites next week. :rocket:
